methods.nested_threshold: F1-max chosen on other donor folds, applied to held fold
methods.bootstrap: donor-level resample x1000; AUROC threshold-free, sens/spec/F1 at fixed operating point
methods.permutation: label shuffle x1000 vs fixed fused OOF AUROC; one-sided p
methods.caveat: fusion weights/orientation held fixed in the permutation (a fully re-fused permutation would be more conservative); nested threshold removes the operating-point optimism but the fusion is still label-aware.
